name: Garrett Emmett
source:
Garrett Emmett, our protagonist. He has migraines that make it painful to be around crowds when it strikes so he's not a very social person by nature. He's prone to sarcasm and being doubtful about things, but he doesn't mean ill. Garrett's quite fond of retro and 8-bit inspired things though they're pretty bad when he has a migraine, making it a bit of a guilty pleasure. He's not very fond of the nickname "G-Force" for obvious reasons.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=20120]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
